name: Amaoto Shizuka
source:
The caretaker of “Uruoi-so,” a 50-year-old apartment building.

Due to certain circumstances, she ended up taking on this job.

She used to have a boyfriend, they were even engaged, but things happened...

[from [url=https://winters.world.coocan.jp/newpage152.html]official site[/url]]
